# HugeHard Studio

> HugeHard Studio is developing “这图能改”, an iOS 17+ photo and video utility. The English-language site calls the app “This Pic Can Change”; the app interface is currently in Simplified Chinese. Its status is Preparing for launch.

The app provides on-device photo and video tools, screenshot delivery, photo and game widgets, and optional AI image generation and editing configured by the user. Ordinary image and video processing runs on device. Optional AI requests go to the configured provider, which may process the submitted content and charge the user. Support: hugehardzhang@gmail.com.
